misconception_description: Confusing a class definition with an instantiated object
learner_response_example: A class allocates memory for variables before you use the object.
recommended_intervention: Clarify that a class is just a design pattern; memory is only allocated when an instance (object) is created.

misconception_description: Believing private attributes are truly secure and inaccessible outside Python
learner_response_example: Private variables cannot be touched at all from outside the file.
recommended_intervention: Explain Python name mangling (_ClassName__attribute) and how it handles private boundaries.

misconception_description: Confusing method overriding with method overloading
learner_response_example: Overriding happens when you have two methods with different parameters in the same class.
recommended_intervention: Remind the learner that overriding replaces a parent method in a child class, while overloading uses different signatures in the same class.
